text.offer: I have faith in you. Go dispatch one of the Princess's soldiers near a flagpole, return to report on your battle, and then we will talk about your future as a soldier.
text.progress: Jonas D'Accor will allow you to join the Rebel army, but first you must prove your loyalty by slaying his enemies at the flagpoles.
text.complete: I knew you were a fit soldier. Now you properly join us in our fight for freedom against tyranny!

steps.brief: Yes, I have heard stories of your fight. Now go conquer one of the Duke's soldiers and you shall join us as an equal when you are done.
